paper_metadata.title: Hybrid quantum investment optimization with minimal holding period

experiments.description: Hybrid quantum-classical dynamic portfolio optimization with a 7-day minimum holding period, evaluated on 50 real assets over a 1-year trading window using D-Wave quantum annealing and post-selection.

algorithm.variant: dynamic portfolio optimization with minimal holding period using quantum sampling and post-selection

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary encoding of asset holdings with ω_n = (1/K) * sum_{q=0}^{Nq-1} 2^q x_{n,q}, where x_{n,q} ∈ {0,1}. Holdings are discretized into integer bundles; with K = 5 and Nq = 2 in the reported experiment.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize H = sum_t [ -μ_t^T ω_t + (γ/2) ω_t^T Σ_t ω_t ] + sum_t ρ (sum_n ω_{t,n} - 1)^2, with Sharpe ratio used to rank candidate portfolios.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty term enforces full investment; minimum holding period enforced by iterative post-selection of candidate trajectories; dimensional reduction via clustering and asset pre-selection by volatility.

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization over a 1-year period with daily rebalancing and a 7-day minimum holding constraint.
